name: D8-fixed-nonlinear-whole-shot-residual-information-gate-v2

one_native_gate_only_if_internal_passes.prediction: On each sealed gate200 INPUT-ONLY row, compute the same 169 shot summary, apply the train1100 scaler and ExtraTrees to produce one constant scaled52 residual per shot. Add it to EVERY frame of that shot's saved fold0 source using the frozen artifact TargetScaler/PCA residual decoder, with exactly one float32 map/scalar cast. A zero residual must reproduce all source bytes; finite output and q95/betaN shapes must be verified. No true gate field may be requested before predictions are sealed.
one_native_gate_only_if_internal_passes.promotion_rule: Only candidate-minus-source native S >=+0.002600 with no increased native failures warrants root review of a new deployable whole-shot model. This is an investment screen on reused validation data, not public-fold confirmation, and does not authorize fitting on the reserved70 or an upload. A failure closes this fixed nonlinear D8 arm without model/HP/split retries.
one_native_gate_only_if_internal_passes.scorer: Score this one candidate through the untouched pinned native local_score on the exact gate200 filenames, using the already scored and hashed B10 fold0 source native JSON as control. Report S, R2psi, R2qb, raw D_LCFS, Consistency, all seven functional R2, native failures, exact filename/prediction/model hashes and stage wall times. Do not score Ridge or ensemble mixtures as extra candidates.

prior_and_limit.interpretation: A train-only result is an investment screen, not evidence of a +0.0014 public gain. A shot-constant correction may be too crude even if mean residual prediction is positive. No hyperparameter search or model-family sweep is implied.
prior_and_limit.old_D8_native_scope: The old 169-summary Ridge on 1000/338 historical early-stopping validation shots had explained variance +0.005938 unweighted and -0.022983 frame-weighted, far below its +0.25 gate. It used an old five-member base whose validation labels had influenced early stopping. This new test uses a genuinely OOF compact MLP source and a different nonlinear multioutput regressor; the old negative is a strong prior, not a theorem about all nonlinear context.

question: Can nonlinear interactions among allowed whole-shot input summaries predict the mean physical-map/scalar residual of an OOF base model where the earlier linear D8 Ridge could not?
resource_estimate_not_measurement: Reuse the existing OOF target and source caches (no new base fit). Extracting 169 summaries and shot-mean targets for 1355 shots should take at most a few CPU minutes; ExtraTrees256 trees x52 outputs on1100 rows may take 1-5 minutes CPU4 and Ridge seconds. If the internal gate passes, constructing 200 corrected maps and one native scorer pass has the already measured order of a few minutes. Resolve actual cgroup/pids and log every stage; estimates are not results.

shot_summary_and_target.input_169: For each shot, compute population mean and population standard deviation over ALL of its frozen selected84 frame features in B10's per-shot cache, plus the input-only duration efit_times[-1]-efit_times[0] in milliseconds; a one-frame shot has exactly 0 ms duration. No true ψ, stored LCFS, q95/betaN, li or other EFIT target is an input. Assert source feature width84 and summary width169, finite, exact shot/frame alignment and input parquet/producer hashes. StandardScaler for 169 inputs is fit only on the1100 fitting shots, then applied without refit to held255/gate200.
shot_summary_and_target.target_52: For each fitting/held shot only, take the mean over all its full frames of the existing B10 cached 52-dimensional TRUE-minus-OOF-source residual in the fold0 artifact's frozen TargetScaler coordinates. This uses true ψ/q95/betaN only for declared OOF training/held255 labels. Every shot contributes one row to both regressors; held-shot frame count is used only in the prespecified validation metric, not to fit a model.
shot_summary_and_target.zero_control: A deterministic zero-residual predictor returns the saved float32 source ψ/q95/betaN bytes exactly; no source-map PCA round-trip or scalar recast is allowed for this control.
